ينعزل (form VII)
# يَنْعَزِلُ (yanʕazilu) /jan.ʕa.zi.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# يَنْعَزِلَ (yanʕazila) /jan.ʕa.zi.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
# يَنْعَزِلْ (yanʕazil) /jan.ʕa.zil/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of اِنْعَزَلَ (inʕazala)
